params.body:
The account page hid "Change plan" from team accounts, because they have the top plan. A team member then had no way from their account to see their plan next to the others.

**Change plan** now shows for every account. This replaces #182, which labelled it "Compare the plans" for team accounts.

Tests: 366 passing.
params.title: Account: Change plan for every account, the team's included
